VermilionCity_House1_Text_FishingIsAWayO.en: Fishing is a way of life!\nIt is like the finest poetry.\pFrom the seas to rivers, go out\nand land the big one, my friend.
VermilionCity_House1_Text_FishingIsAWayO.fr: La pêche c'est comme la vie !\pQuand ça mord, ça va ! Quand ça\nmord pas, ça va pas !

VermilionCity_House1_Text_HowAreTheFishB.en: Hello there, {PLAYER}!\pHow are the fish biting?

VermilionCity_House1_Text_ImFishingGuruD.en: I'm the FISHING GURU!\pI simply looove fishing!\nI can't bear to go without.\pTell me, do you like to fish?
VermilionCity_House1_Text_ImFishingGuruD.fr: Je suis le… MAÎTRE PÊCHEUR !\pLa pêche… moi… J'adore ça !\pEt toi, p'tite tête ?

VermilionCity_House1_Text_NoRoomForNiceG.en: Oh, no!\pI had a nice gift for you, but you\nhave no room for it!
VermilionCity_House1_Text_NoRoomForNiceG.fr: Ha ben non !\pJ'avais un cadeau pour toi, mais\nt'as plus de place !

VermilionCity_House1_Text_ReceivedOldRod.en: {PLAYER} received an OLD ROD from\nthe FISHING GURU.
VermilionCity_House1_Text_ReceivedOldRod.fr: {PLAYER} a reçu une VIEILLE CANNE du\nGOUROU DE LA PÊCHE.

VermilionCity_House1_Text_TakeThisAndFis.en: Grand! I like your style.\nI think we can be friends.\pTake this and fish, young friend!
VermilionCity_House1_Text_TakeThisAndFis.fr: Cool ! T'as l'air de quelqu'un de\nbien !\pPrends ça ! Que la Grand' Pêche\nsoit avec toi !
